notes: Document: Protocol NN9536-4378, version 3.0 (Final, 29 June 2018), 'Updated protocol including amendment 1' (original protocol version 2.0, 14 May 2018). PDF page 1 is a ClinicalTrials.gov cover page and PDF page 2 (image) a CTR Appendix 16.1.1 list of contents; protocol pages 1-94 are PDF pages 3-96; PDF page 97 is the Attachments I and II placeholder. Only one protocol version is in the PDF; the SoA (flowchart, PDF pages 11-14, printed version 3.0) comes from it, so all content is from v3.0. Amendment 1 (summarised on PDF page 4) added the Control of Eating Questionnaire (CoEQ) at baseline, week 20, week 52 and week 104, US and Canada only; it is already incorporated in v3.0, so no separate amendment entries were needed. Text layer: this PDF's text layer inserts spaces inside words (e.g. 'Pr ot oc ol'); quotes and abbreviation terms/definitions are copied from it as printed in the text layer, so they carry those spaces. Pages without a text layer: 2, 11-14 (the flowchart), 28, 30, 38, 49, 50, 77. Read from images: 11-14 (SoA rows, the section/appendix links next to row names, footnotes a-d — used for PHQ-9 and C-SSRS abbreviations and for SoA footnote evidence), 28 (Table 7-2 dose escalation, missed-dose rules; nothing extracted), 30 (TEE/BMR calculation, 7.2-7.4; nothing extracted), 38 (Figure 9-1 and Table 9-1 AE forms; nothing extracted), 77 (Appendix 4 continuation; confirms Appendix 4 does not cover technical complaints), 2 (CTR list of contents). Pages 49-50 (statistics) not read. Rule 10: the lab-tests tables (Table 11-1 on page 63, Table 11-2 on page 64) were checked against the page images; the text layer lists each panel's parameters in order and the assignments agree with the images. Conflicts / points to note: (1) Pregnancy test lab: Section 9.4.5 (page 44) says urine pregnancy tests are provided by the central laboratory, while Table 11-2 note 5 (page 64) says local urine testing will be standard unless serum testing is required by local regulation or IRB/IEC — both recorded. (2) The SoA row 'Technical complaint' points to Section 9.2.9 and Appendix 4; Appendix 4 (pages 76-81) covers adverse events and does not mention technical complaints; Section 9.2.9 (page 41) says the definitions and reporting process for technical complaints are in Appendix 6 (pages 85-86). (3) The SoA cross-reference numbers appear as links beside the row names (not as footnotes); 'See Appendix 2' for laboratory rows refers to 'Appendix 2 Clinical laboratory tests' (the table of contents text layer misaligns appendix numbers and titles; the appendix pages themselves are unambiguous). (4) Calcitonin is part of Biochemistry (Table 11-2) and Appendix 7 describes calcitonin monitoring; amylase, calcitonin and lipase are not collected at week 84 (Table 11-2 note 3). (5) The CoEQ text lists a domain as 'Carving for Sweet' (as printed). Not found / not covered: no specimen is stated for the haematology and biochemistry panels beyond 'blood sample' wording for calcitonin; no units are stated for ECG; no recall period is printed for any instrument; no abbreviation definition is printed for 'ID' (SoA row 'Hand out ID card'); Section 9 says at screening subjects are provided with a card stating that they are participating in a trial. SoA rows with no descriptive text beyond their name: 'First date on trial product', 'IWRS session', 'Dispensing visit', 'Hand out ID card' (described only by the Section 9 card sentence), 'Tobacco use' (described only by SoA footnote c, smoking definition), 'Informed consent and Demography' (demography content from SoA footnote a). Abbreviations: Appendix 1 list (pages 60-62, 62 entries) plus HDL, VLDL (Table 11-1), hCG, UNL, INR (Table 11-2 and notes) and PHQ-9, C-SSRS (SoA row names, page 13 image) which the list does not define. Updated 2026-11-07 to schema 1.1 (no re-extraction): instruments carry kind; letter-spaced abbreviation terms and definitions re-spaced (whitespace only, checked from page images).
